manual_review_checklist: Watch the full export at native speed with sound (no jump cuts in review)
Watch muted: clear subject, hierarchy, narrative meaning and readable holds
Inspect 3D geometry, real depth/occlusion, subject paths, collisions and continuity
Inspect typography, lighting, textures, color/alpha edges and transition boundaries
Listen without video: VO intelligibility, SFX material/weight, music arc and quiet moments
Check sound attacks at contact frames; no pops, clipping, masking or ducking pump
Check on phone/small viewing size and low volume where relevant
Confirm licensed assets and exact edited scene/character/audio revisions match export
